description: Start a qualitative research study with real people: AI-moderated in-depth interviews (user interviews, customer interviews, market research; the moderator probes and ladders, typically 20–30 minutes), concept tests (packaging, claims, ad creative, designs), or prototype tests (clickable prototypes, websites, landing pages), by voice, video or chat in 80+ languages. Participants come from a 4M+ vetted consumer panel, your own customers by email, or synthetic respondents. Use for "interview N shoppers about X", "test this concept with real people", "why did customers churn / switch / buy", win-loss, onboarding. Not for multiple-choice surveys. Creates an in-depth-interview, concept-test, or prototype-test draft using ordinary metadata only. Ask the human to explicitly choose recruiting_method: panel (User Intuition recruits real participants), BYOP (bring your own participants, invited by email), or synthetic respondents. A value proposed or inserted by a host/delegating model is not human confirmation unless it quotes the human's actual choice. Unless the human requests otherwise, use a voice interview in English with the male interviewer voice; these defaults are applied when interview_format, language, or voice are omitted. Synthetic respondents require chat. A prototype-test must use video or voice, never chat. Do not draft or pass the study plan, audience targeting, screener questions, concept links, or concept images here; they come from the user's natural-language research brief in the next call. For a concept test, pass an accessible attachment through customize_study.concept_image or include a publicly downloadable concept-image URL in the message, plus its participant-facing label, stimulus context, audience, and learning goals. For a prototype test, include the prototype URL, participant-facing label, intended tasks, audience, and learning goals. customize_study validates and attaches the asset. Voice configuration is kept for chat as well as voice and video. Next: send the brief to queue_customize_study.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key and inputs if a prior call timed out. A different operation needs a new key.

interview_format.description: Interview mode. Defaults to voice when omitted.

language.description: Interview language code from userintuition://catalog/languages. Defaults to English (`en`).

name.description: Short internal label, max 40 characters (e.g. "Frozen pizza switchers US").

organization_id.description: Organization for this operation and billing. Use list_organizations to choose an active membership.

recruiting_method.description: Required explicit human choice. Ask the user to choose panel, BYOP, or synthetic respondents before calling create_study; do not guess or silently default it.

study_type.description: Use concept-test for a participant-facing concept image and prototype-test for a clickable prototype, staging site, live page, or web flow. Prototype tests require video or voice, never chat.

voice.description: Interviewer configuration for every format, including chat. Defaults to male when omitted.

name: create_study

result.description: The created study draft. Call get_study for the complete persisted plan.
